Skywalker, attack the front gate, Ahsoka, you scale the back wall, we'll meet in the middle.|Plo Koon|audio=SecondBattleofFelucia1.flac|}} The '''Second Battle of Felucia''' occurred in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when forces from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|clashed]] over control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Having been forced into a retreat at the previous [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]], the Republic re-established a presence there thanks to the efforts of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who led their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] on an offensive into Separatist-held territory. In retaliation, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] supplied [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|one]] of his outposts on Felucia with reinforcements from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] to secure the [[Felucia system/Legends|system]] for the Confederacy. Responding to the arrival of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] detachment, Skywalker, Tano, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] targeted the enemy outpost with a three-pronged assault, each leading a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to divide the Separatist defenses. Supported by heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] situated on an adjacent ridge, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] were able to secure the base from [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33]], eliminating all of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces there. However, Tano was captured during the fighting by a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], who brought her to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] to be [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|hunted]] for sport. Skywalker and Koon withdrew from Felucia the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|The setback at Felucia has affected our efforts in the whole sector. It'll take weeks before we can…|Obi-Wan Kenobi, following the First Battle of Felucia|audio=SecondBattleofFelucia2.flac|{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}}} [[File:BlockadeofFelucia.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic Grand Army was forced to retreat during the First Battle of Felucia.]] During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fought to claim the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], which was valued for its close proximity to the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war,{{TCWdates|201}} [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the latter's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], defended Felucia from a Separatist assault headed by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]],{{DB|location|felucia|Felucia}} but their forces were overwhelmed and forced to retreat with the aid of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. The Republic's defeat at the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]] impeded the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] efforts in the entire [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]], and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] installed several outposts on Felucia. The Confederacy's control over the world also enabled a [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station/Legends|destroy]] a [[Felucia medical station/Legends|Republic medical station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}} Despite becoming a Separatist stronghold,{{TCWA|Galactic Forces}} Felucia remained a contested site for much of the war, with its native [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] attempting to stay out of the conflict.{{SWE|locations|felucia|Felucia}} In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the Republic was able to re-establish a presence on Felucia when Skywalker and Tano returned with a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachment from the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]], mounting a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground campaign]] against Grievous's forces. ==The battle== {{Quote|Form up for counter attack. Lower the gate.|TZ-33, responding to the Republic's artillery offensive|audio=TZ-33-Form_Up.flac|}} Leading a [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]], Skywalker, Tano, and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] advanced into Separatist-held territory on Felucia. The Confederacy deployed numerous [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], comprising [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]], to halt the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones, who engaged the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] along their path through the dense foliage. Skywalker, Tano, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex, and their men held their position, pressing deeper into Confederate territory. As the clone [[Tank/Legends|tank]] division battled on into the night, Jedi General Plo Koon arrived aboard his [[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]] with an escort of two [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]], rendezvousing with Skywalker and Tano along with his [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]]—[[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]]—and their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] from the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion's]] [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]]. With Confederate control of the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]] in jeopardy, General Grievous dispatched droid reinforcements aboard a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] to [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|one]] of his outposts on Felucia, which was being overseen by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33]]. Learning of Grievous's reinforcements, the Republic forces resolved to cut off the Separatist detachment at the source. [[File:PloKoonKickingArseOnFelucia-PL.png|thumb|right|250px|The clone troopers led by Koon, Skywalker, and Tano capture TZ-33's outpost.]] Koon, Skywalker, Tano, and their men proceeded to TZ-33's outpost, which had been constructed from a [[CIS mobile command center/Legends|mobile command center]]. Skywalker brought along several Felucians as [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], having become acquainted with them during a previous trip to Felucia. The Republic forces covertly secured a ridge overlooking the base, where they positioned two AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and a [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|Juggernaut tank]]. The Separatist [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] soon arrived, unloading its B1 battle droids and [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] to augment TZ-33's troops. Observing the droids from their vantage point, Koon devised a plan to divide the enemy defenses: while he scaled the base's left side, Skywalker would assault the front gate, and Tano would lead a squad over the rear wall. All three Jedi-led teams would then close in on the command center. With their strategy in place, the Jedi [[Officer/Legends|officers]] moved into place, being careful not to alert the Separatists to their presence. Utilizing a trail charted by their Felucian scouts, Skywalker, Rex, and their squad reached the path leading to the front gate, while Koon and Wolffe stopped with their Wolfpack troops in front of the left flank. Tano was also given a small detail from the Wolfpack, including [[Corporal/Legends|Clone Corporal]] [[Comet (clone trooper)/Legends|Comet]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]], and trooper [[Boost/Legends|Boost]]. After Skywalker and Tano reported via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] that their men were in position, Koon ordered the AT-TE walkers on the ridge to fire upon the outpost, just as TZ-33's forces detected the tanks via scanning. The [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone tank gunners]] rained down long-range [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] fire, baiting TZ-33 into marshaling a counteroffensive. Once TZ-33's frontal flank of B1 battle droids and dwarf [[Spider/Legends|spider]] droids marched out the front gate, Skywalker activated his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and began his attack, cutting through the droids alongside his men. Meanwhile, Koon [[Force jump/Legends|jumped]] over the left wall with the aid of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], with Wolffe and their [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] following with their [[JT-12 jetpack/Legends|JT-12 jetpacks]]. While Koon and Wolffe engaged droids at their position, Tano had Sinker and Comet shoot down the rear wall's two droid guards, allowing their team to [[Ascension gun/Legends|grapple]] over the barrier. Before Tano could join them, she was incapacitated via [[Stun net/Legends|stun net]] by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]], who captured her so that she could be subjected to a ritualistic Trandoshan hunt. Pressing through the battle droids, dwarf spider droids, and droid [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] defending the base's interior, Skywalker, Koon, and their men converged on the command center alongside Tano's squad. Skywalker jumped onto the command deck and destroyed TZ-33, securing the Republic's control over the outpost. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|The outpost is secure. Good job, Corporal. Where's Commander Tano?''"
"''She was covering our flank when we scaled the wall.''"
"''Everybody fan out. I want a perimeter sweep now.|Anakin Skywalker and Comet|audio=SecondBattleofFelucia4.flac|}} [[File:FeluciaMorningAfter1-PL.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and his men search for Tano around the captured outpost, to no avail.]] With the fall of TZ-33's base, the Second Battle of Felucia, as it came to be known,{{FactFile2013|1|FEL 1-4|Felucia}} resulted in a victory for the Republic. After receiving a report from Comet and realizing that Tano was missing, Skywalker dispatched several squads of troopers to sweep the perimeter of the outpost. Yet the Republic forces were too late to prevent Tano from being transported off-world by the Trandoshans. She was taken to the [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], where she was deposited on an [[Island Four/Legends|island site]] to be [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|hunted]] for sport alongside other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. Although Skywalker was unable to locate his missing Padawan on Felucia, Koon ensured that every Grand Army detachment in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as well as all Republic [[Spy/Legends|agents]] within the Confederacy itself, were notified of Tano's disappearance. The [[Standard day/Legends|morning]] after the battle, Koon and Skywalker received orders to recall their forces from Felucia, and they left aboard a [[Plo's Bros/Legends|convoy]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]]. Returning to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Skywalker continued to conduct searches for Tano, who was later rescued from Wasskah by a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors.{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}} Jedi involved in the Second Battle of Felucia documented their experiences in a collection of [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] later published as the [[Jedi Battle Logs]].{{TCWA|coll=Jedi Battle Logs Vol 2}} Although the Second Battle of Felucia marked a victory for the Republic, Felucia continued to be a key battlefield in the ongoing war, with the Separatist-allied [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] establishing a heavy presence on the world.''[[Reversal of Fortune]]'' In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the war's final year,''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' Jedi General [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] led a detachment from the Republic's [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] to [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|secure]] Felucia from the Confederacy as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].{{Film|III}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Located near a major hyperspace lane, the planet Felucia is caught in an unending battle between Republic and Separatist forces.|Newsreel for "Padawan Lost"|audio=SecondBattleofFelucia5.flac|}} The Second Battle of Felucia was featured in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and first appeared in the episode "[[Padawan Lost]]," which aired on [[April 1]], [[2011]] as the finale for the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]]. The episode's opening Newsreel stated that the battle was "unending," implying that it was a continuation of the First Battle of Felucia, which was featured in the earlier [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Holocron Heist]]." Felucia's [http://www.starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/locations/felucia entry] in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] later confirmed that the two engagements were separate. The entry also verified that the battle from "Padawan Lost" occurred after the First Battle of Felucia, with that chronology being repeated in the publication ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''. The new edition of ''The Ultimate Visual Guide'' also placed the battle within the overall timeline of the series, as established by [[Holocron continuity database]] manager [[Leland Chee]]. "Padawan Lost" originally provided the engagement with the "Battle of Felucia" name, which was further specified to the "Second Battle of Felucia" in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 1 (2013)|first issue]] of a [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2013)|remake]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] *{{TCW|Padawan Lost}} {{1st}} {{C|As Battle of Felucia}} *{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 66|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 66]] {{Imo}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}} *[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 67|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 67]] {{Imo}} *{{SWArchive|url=games/clonewars_adventures_iceberg3/index.html|text=New ''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' Summer Series - ''Mission on Iceberg Three''}} {{C|no longer available}} *{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep321|text="Padawan Lost" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Annual 2012]]'' *{{FactFile2013|1|FEL 1-4|Felucia}} {{1stID|Second Battle of Felucia}} *{{FactFile2014|1|FEL 1-4|Felucia}} *{{SWE|characters|ahsokatano|Ahsoka Tano}} {{Imo}} *{{SWE|characters|clonecommanderwolffe|Clone Commander Wolffe}} *{{SWE|locations|felucia|Felucia}} *{{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}} *{{FactFile2014|25|GUN 1-2|LAAT/i Republic Gunship}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Zweite Schlacht von Felucia |pl=Druga bitwa o Felucję }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Felucia, Second Battle of}} [[Category:Battles of Felucia]] [[Category:Battles of the Clone Wars]]
